glass: old-fashioned glass (rocks glass), filled with crushed ice
_notes: Proper pp. 31-32 printed Bramble (2 oz gin, 3/4 oz lemon, 1/2 oz simple, 1/2 oz creme de mure; blackberry and lemon wedge), measures read off the rendered page. Ours adds 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) balsamic vinegar stirred into the mure before it is drizzled over the crushed ice (Matrix pdf 52: vinegar among berries' best pairings). Mure values PROVISIONAL (16%, 25 g/100 ml, EU floor, unsourced); swept against cassis 40 g as sweet bound; gin swept 40/41.2/47. Oxford's printed 60/30/15 rich/15 is OUT on acid.
